heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Can you port my mobile game to PC?
items.answer: Yes. We rework controls, UI and graphics to suit the desktop.

items.question: Do you support game controllers?
items.answer: Yes. Keyboard, mouse and common controllers are supported.

items.question: Can I release on Mac too?
items.answer: Yes. A Unity project can also produce a Mac build.

items.question: How long does windows game development take?
items.answer: A simple casual game takes about 2 to 3 months, while a polished 3D or multiplayer game usually takes 6 months or more.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
